shieldCandidate.name: Wooden shield
shieldCandidate.description: Bind three worked branches into a rigid shield using two fiber cords.

output.name: Wooden shield
output.description: A wooden off-hand shield that can share both hands with a knife. Choose Guard to reduce one timely front contact blow.

bowCandidate.name: Field bow
bowCandidate.description: An authored flexible branch bow with a cord string.

output.name: Field bow
output.description: A bow held in both hands. It launches compatible finite arrows; a carried knife or shield requires changing equipment.

arrowCandidate.name: Field arrow
arrowCandidate.description: A shaft with a bone point and fiber fletching.

output.name: Field arrow
output.description: One ordinary compatible arrow. Its point adds no injury beyond the bow’s shot.

labels.instruction: Release in the inner patterned band for strong timing, or the outer band for ordinary timing. Timing does not guarantee a hit.
